title: Show logged-in users and their activity
summary: Display a list of users currently logged into the Mac, including their login time, idle time, and what they are doing.

steps.explain: Run the `w` command to display information about all users currently logged in, including their terminal, remote host, login time, idle time, and current process.
steps.expect: A table listing users, their TTYs, login times, and current activities.

alternatives.explain: Display the same information but without the column headers.
Display the information sorted by idle time, showing the most active users first.
